author: GameTrailers
description: Become a gatekeeper at an isolated outpost. Perform daily duties, inspect trading wagons, patrol the grounds, and maintain the weathered station as you begin to discover something is terribly wrong with this place. Take a look at gameplay and the creepy world of Dreadwoods Gatekeeper in this trailer for the upcoming narrative horror sim game. Dreadwoods Gatekeeper will be available on PC. You can wishlist Dreadwoods Gatekeeper on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/
title: Dreadwoods Gatekeeper - Official Gameplay Trailer

description:
The new chapter is coming! Get ready for Scrap Mechanic: Drilling Thunder, coming July 24th 2026! #Ad

This monumental 1.0 release comes packed with brand new content for the survival experience, alongside a big graphical upgrade!

Enter the creative paradise of Scrap Mechanic! Build fantastic machines, go on adventures with your friends and defend against waves of evil Farmbots in this imaginative multiplayer survival sandbox. With Scrap Mechanic’s powerful creation tools you can engineer your own adventures!

Get Scrap Mechanic on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/387990/Scrap_Mechanic/
title: Scrap Mechanic: 1.0 & Drilling Thunder - Release Date Trailer
